**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- **§ 12.3** (p0051) affirmatively preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and records Vendor's acknowledgement that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 2.1** (p0013) reinforces this: no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and declining to sign another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 12.4** runs in our favour (Vendor may not market a directly competing analytics service) — exclusivity benefiting Customer, so not flagged.
- Remaining "exclusive" hits (§ 13 non-exclusive licence, § 19/§ 21/§ 30 exclusive remedy, § 28 exclusive jurisdiction) are unrelated to exclusive dealing.

No redline proposed.
